state:
**Goal `ext-host` — an extension loads under its pin, runs once per request on its request's core, and stays inside that request's budget — is in Stage 2.** The configuration half is on disk; nothing reads a `.nvsx` yet. The design is ADR 0246 §§ 3–6 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*, which no session re-decides; this goal has no record slot.

On disk: `crates/nvs-config/src/tree.rs`'s `Extension` has `path`, `sha256` and the optional `memory` ceiling (a `Setting`, read as a size). `crates/nvs-config/src/extension.rs`'s `validate`, called from `resolve`, refuses an entry with no `path`, no `sha256` or a pin that is not 64 hex digits (either case) as `E0651`, pointing at the entry's line in the file that wrote it, and a `memory` that is not a size as `E0601`; `is_pin` is public for the loader. Tests are `crates/nvs-config/tests/extension.rs`. The shipped template's `[[extension]]` block says both keys are required. There is no `crates/nvs-ext`; add its paths to the record with `bun nv goal context --add` as they land.

next.title: the loader
next.note: one file set: a new `crates/nvs-ext` (`Cargo.toml`, `src/lib.rs`, `src/load.rs`, `src/manifest.rs`, `tests/load.rs`), the workspace `Cargo.toml`.

items.text: **The crate and the manifest model** — a new `crates/nvs-ext` (wasmtime with component model, async and pooling, the features `benches/abi-probe/Cargo.toml:24` already takes; `sha2`; `serde_json`; all three are in the root manifest's `[workspace.dependencies]`). The manifest type, its parser and the section reader sit where `nvs-types` can depend on them without wasmtime; the place is written in the module doc. `rule:packaging/an-nvsx-is-one-file-carrying-its-manifest`.

**Load, in 0246 § 4's order, each refusal naming the entry** — digest against pin, compared case-insensitively since `crates/nvs-config/src/extension.rs:55`'s `is_pin` accepts either case, then validation, both sections, the manifest against the exports through 0246 § 1's table, imports against `wit/nvs-ext/`'s world, `Core\`/`Novis\` classes (`rule:core-api/core-means-always-present`), a duplicate class, a world version outside `1.x`. Guests are component WAT text with the sections added by a test helper; tests in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/load.rs`. `rule:packaging/extension-loading-is-root-controlled`.

backlog: **Stage 3: the packer** — `crates/nvs-ext/src/pack.rs` with `wit-component` 0.254 added to `[workspace.dependencies]`; deterministic output that Stage 2's load accepts. Shares the crate with Stage 2's loader.

**Stage 4: instances, the call bridge and the budget** — the engine and the per-request instances in `crates/nvs-ext/src/`, parking through `crates/nvs-host/src/scheduler.rs:1376` and `crates/nvs-host/src/reactor.rs:824`, the CPU check in the epoch callback (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/limits.rs:495`), the memory charge through `crates/nvs-runtime/src/budget.rs:383` with the entry's `memory` ceiling as one of the three bounds, the drop at `crates/nvs-host/src/isolate.rs:1155`.
**Stage 5: failures** — `ExtensionError` in `crates/nvs-hir/src/errors.rs:96` and `crates/nvs-runtime/src/throwable.rs:318`, then the mapping in `crates/nvs-ext`. Two file sets.

**Stage 6: reload and the module cache** — the cache seam in `crates/nvs-ext` filled by `crates/nvs-cli/src/cache.rs`, then boot and `crates/nvs-cli/src/control.rs:602`'s reload with tests in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs` and `compile_cache.rs`. Two file sets.

`crates/nvs-config/src/cache.rs:633`'s `extension_set_hash` still falls back to an entry's path when it has no pin; a resolved tree can no longer hold one, so the fallback only serves trees built without `resolve`. Leave it unless Stage 6 touches it.
When this goal's last check goes green the driver takes goal `ext-compiler`.
